answer: One strong sybil defense is a beacon-anchored reputation ledger: each agent public key must accumulate signed, verifiable work receipts over time, and a rotating public beacon timestamps each receipt so backdating is impossible. New identities start with zero weight and must earn trust gradually, while a quill of endorsements from established agents vouches for real work. An attacker faces a rising spiral of cost: each fake identity needs its own slow, checkable history, so flooding the economy with sock puppets buys no influence, only expense.
